name: Truffle Mushroom Penne
description: Penne pasta tossed in a rich, creamy black truffle sauce with sautéed wild mushrooms and freshly grated parmesan cheese.

name: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: Stone-baked sourdough base topped with rich tomato passata, fresh buffalo mozzarella, fragrant basil leaves, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

name: Decadent Tiramisu
description: Layers of espresso-soaked ladyfingers and velvety mascarpone cream, dusted with cocoa powder.

name: Double Cheddar Bacon Smash
description: Two smashed beef patties, double sharp cheddar cheese, applewood smoked bacon, caramelized onions, and signature boss sauce on a buttered brioche bun.

name: Sweet Potato Waffle Fries
description: Crispy sweet potato waffle fries, lightly salted and served with spicy honey mustard.

name: Signature Rainbow Roll
description: Snow crab, avocado, and cucumber inside, draped with fresh slices of tuna, salmon, yellowtail, and shrimp, garnished with tobiko.

name: Edamame with Sea Salt
description: Steamed organic edamame pods sprinkled with coarse sea salt.

name: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with juicy chicken, infused with authentic Indian spices, caramelised onions, fresh mint, and coriander, cooked dum-style.

name: Garlic Butter Naan
description: Traditional leavened flatbread brushed with fresh garlic and melted butter.

name: Avocado Quinoa Salad Bowl
description: Fresh spinach, red quinoa, organic avocado slices, roasted chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber, served with a zesty lemon-herb vinaigrette.

name: Green Goddess Smoothie
description: Refreshing blend of baby spinach, kale, green apple, banana, ginger, and coconut water.

name: Classic Belgian Waffle
description: Crisp Belgian waffle topped with fresh strawberries, whipped cream, and warm maple syrup.

name: Chocolate Fudge Waffle
description: Waffle loaded with dark chocolate chips, drizzled with warm chocolate fudge and sprinkled with powdered sugar.

name: Chipotle Chicken Tacos (3x)
description: Three soft corn tortillas filled with grilled chipotle chicken, pico de gallo, crumbled cotija cheese, and cilantro lime crema.

name: Chips & Guacamole
description: Freshly fried tortilla chips served with house-made guacamole using hass avocados, lime, and cilantro.

name: Pepperoni Passion Pizza
description: Classic tomato base topped with mozzarella and double portions of spicy pepperoni.

name: BBQ Chicken Pizza
description: Tangy BBQ sauce base, grilled chicken breast strips, red onions, cilantro, and smoked gouda cheese.
